text:
Amanda: Heads up — spike into /generate from eu-west started ~10m ago, backend queues climbing, p95 latency doubled. seeing a lot of 503s from worker pool.
Vik: yup saw it in the traffic corridor too. looks like a single customer shard + some user-side loops. p50 -> 420ms, p95 -> 1.2s.
Priya: tagging @oncall-bot incident if we want an official incident id? also suggest we flip to a mitigation path instead of full rollback.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-E1 (priority: high) — responders: Vik, Amanda, Jesse.
Jesse: proposal: enable an emergency "quarantine" routing policy that: 1) matches the noisy customer prefix, 2) strips heavy streaming headers, 3) routes to a cached-response tier (model-lite / short-context) or a cheap fallback model. low-risk and fast.
Amanda: +1. We should gate behind telemetry: only flip if backend queue > 70% for >2min. avoid flip loops.
Vik: agree. also need console visibility: when quarantine is active it must show which rule matched and sampled tokens saved. otherwise SRE will be blind.
Carlos: quick API for toggle exists: internal admin endpoint /admin/routing/toggle. sample cmd:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/routing/toggle" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"route":"quarantine-eu-west-01","enable":true,"match":{"path_prefix":"/v1/generate","customer_id":"cust-847"},"action":{"rewrite_headers":{"X-Egress-Plan":"quarantine"},"target":"model-lite-v1","max_requests_per_min":300}}'
```
Priya: we should avoid using free-text rules. use a short-lived rule id + linkage to rollback metadata. e.g. attach `meta.origin=hotfix/INC-2026-0423` and `meta-owner=oncall`. also set `ttl=15m` so it auto-reverts if nobody touches it.
Jesse: agree. add a precheck: api returns dry-run summary: `would divert 18% of traffic, est tokens saved 46k/hr`. run dry-run before flip.
Amanda: can someone add the telemetry query we want to gate on? e.g.:
```
select max(queue_ratio) from service.queues where region='eu-west' and route like '/v1/generate' over 2m
```
Vik: I'll wire the query into the toggle call. admin API will evaluate and abort if threshold not met.
Carlos: deploying the toggle now in dry-run mode with `ttl=15m` and `dry_run=true`. will post results in 30s.
deploy-bot: rollout started by Carlos — toggle/quarantine-eu-west-01 (dry_run=true, ttl=15m) — change id: ch-2026-0423-77.
Vik: dry-run summary: would divert 22% of matching traffic, est 52k tokens/hr saved, p95 backend latency delta if diverted: -380ms.
Priya: looks good. when enabling fully, we must: 1) set telemetry annotations in the console 2) emit an audit entry to the incident 3) notify customers team if their shard is impacted.
Amanda: admin flip now? (queue_ratio > 0.72 for 3min yes).
Jesse: flipping. command: `POST /admin/routing/toggle {enable:true, id:quarantine-eu-west-01, dry_run:false}`.
Carlos: executed enable command. setting `meta.origin=hotfix/INC-2026-0423`, `meta-ttl=1h`.
deploy-bot: toggle/quarantine-eu-west-01 enabled (change id ch-2026-0423-77) — metadata: origin=hotfix/INC-2026-0423 ttl=3600s.
Vik: immediate improvement in backend queue length and p95 dropping ~350ms.
Priya: console note: added telemetry card "quarantine-eu-west-01" under Rollouts -> Active Hotfixes, showing match sample, diverted rate, tokens saved.
Amanda: great. keep it for now but we need a rollback procedure documented in thread. If error or customer complaint: rollback steps: 1) POST /admin/routing/toggle enable=false id=quarantine-eu-west-01 2) set `meta.note='rollback INC-2026-0423'` 3) open a followup task to investigate root cause + permanent mitigations.
Jesse: also add an automated fallback: if error-rate for matched traffic > 5% after flip, auto-revert. admin API supports `auto_revert_on_error=true`. we should enable it.
Carlos: enabling auto_revert_on_error=true for this rule.
Amanda: record lessons: console should surface what headers were rewritten and which model variant was used (we had to guess from logs). add a UX request to product: single-click hotfix with validated dry-run and telemetry gate.
Vik: filing a short ticket: PRODX-1492 "Hotfix toggle UX: dry-run + telemetry gate + auto-revert".
Priya: also recommend we create a small runbook snippet in /playbooks/incidents for this pattern: "quarantine-route -> dry-run -> verify metrics -> enable + monitor 10m -> extend TTL or escalate to dedicated mitigations".
Amanda: thanks all. leaving this thread open for followups. will close incident after stability for 30m.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 update: quarantine toggle active — metrics improving. next update in 10m.
